locator.section: 05-26 S. Philippi Nerii Confessoris; secreta; proper w001–w021 only; supplied conclusion and Amen excluded

entries.claim: This setting prints the complete 21-word secreta proper w001–w021, followed by the literal local cue “Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte eiúsdem Spíritus Sancti.” This local cue already extends through Sancti, but does not print Deus, the duration or Amen.

locator.section: RG115a+e; w022–w043 and Amen w044 only; proper body excluded; stress/punctuation controls, not a contiguous occasion paragraph

entries.claim: This setting’s RG115a+e supplies the complete Father-directed conclusion and response w022–w043 and Amen w044 only; proper body excluded. The literal RG115a list has tuum, qui and Amen; and is unaccented. Same-edition p.123 supports selected common stress and tuum: Qui, not the selected Deus comma; that comma is printed in RG115a. The p.226 terminal supports duration stress and the separate Amen period. RG115e supplies the rubric insertion eiusdem; its selected accent is directly printed in the local p.539 cue, not proved by p.123. These controls do not establish actors, singing or the distribution of conclusions in grouped orations.

locator.section: RG115a+e; w022–w043 and Amen w044 only; proper body excluded; explicitly supplied same-edition ending

entries.claim: This setting’s own RG115a+e supplies its complete conclusion and response w022–w043 and Amen w044 only; proper body excluded. The RG115e eiusdem insertion is explicit rubric-based composition, not a contiguous RG115a quotation. Literal accents, Christum comma, tuum, qui and Amen list semicolon are retained. Wording alone establishes no actors, singing, participation or grouped-orations conclusion distribution.
